babs.1: Mentioning (Allah's name) over food and eating with the right hand
babs.2: Whoever followed (the food) around the bowl with his companion if he knew no dislike from him
babs.3: Starting with the right in eating and other things
babs.4: Whoever ate until he was full
babs.5: Thin bread and eating at a table and on a dining mat
babs.7: The Prophet ﷺ would not eat until it was named for him so he knew what it was
babs.9: The believer eats in one intestine
babs.18: The Prophet ﷺ never criticized any food
babs.20: What the Prophet ﷺ and his Companions used to eat
babs.23: A scalded sheep, the shoulder and the side
babs.24: What the predecessors used to store of food in their houses and on journeys
babs.25: Hays (a dish of dates, butter and curd)
babs.31: A man taking trouble to prepare food for his brothers
babs.32: Whoever invited a man to food and went on with his own work
babs.35: Whoever handed or offered his companion something at the table
babs.41: Eating dates two at a time
babs.43: The blessing of the date palm
babs.44: Combining two kinds or two foods at once
babs.45: Whoever admitted guests ten at a time, and sitting at food ten at a time
babs.46: What is disliked of garlic and herbs
babs.47: Al-kabath, the fruit of the arak tree
babs.49: Licking and sucking the fingers before wiping them with a napkin
babs.51: What one says when he finishes his food
babs.54: A man is invited to food and says: "And this one is with me"
babs.55: When supper is served, one should not hasten away from it
babs.56: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "And when you have eaten, disperse"
